The practices span board-level oversight and organization-wide risk governance, plus lifecycle controls for use-case assessment, model selection, data, transparency, performance, human oversight, cyber/ICT and third-party dependencies. The FSB says the report was revised after public consultation, including broader documentation and third-party-risk treatment and additional discussion of agentic and multi-agent systems. It calls the practices an adaptable toolkit rather than a binding standard; the report says agentic-specific guidance remains nascent.

item.title: GPT-Live-1.1 system card reports voice-safety regressions on synthetic adversarial prompts
item.description: OpenAI's October 15 GPT-Live-1.1 system card reports mixed voice-safety evaluation results. On its voice-native production-prompt set, the company reports no statistically significant regressions versus GPT-Live-1. On its deliberately difficult synthetic-prompt set, it reports statistically significant regressions for GPT-Live-1.1 in sexual, mental-health, emotional-reliance and gore categories; it also reports slight regression on a restrictions-respect evaluation and mixed changes on blocker-disclosure and broken-search tasks. These are first-party results, and neither prompt set estimates safety-event prevalence in production traffic.

item.title: Anthropic reports six METR evaluators onboarded with employee-like access and publication rights
item.description: On October 15, 2026, Anthropic reported that it had onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space and access to internal tools and systems roughly comparable to those used by its risk-assessment teams. Anthropic says METR may publish analyses of its risk levels, incidents and practices; Anthropic cannot veto publication but may require redactions within narrow predefined categories, and METR may characterize those redactions publicly. The team is siloed from other METR work. This is a first-party report of an operating access arrangement, not independent confirmation of practical access or evaluator independence. The post reports no completed evaluation findings or safety outcome.

item.title: Cognizant reports a 75M transformer reached about 76% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation tasks
item.description: A September 21, 2026 Cognizant AI Lab post and linked public repository describe a 75-million-parameter autoregressive transformer trained from scratch for ARC-AGI. Cognizant reports about 76% pass@2 on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set after a little over four hours of training and evaluation on one NVIDIA H100; an eight-model ensemble reportedly reaches about 80%. The post also reports about 17% on ARC-AGI-2 for one model and about 22% for the ensemble, while a faster approximately 17-minute configuration reaches about 44% on ARC-AGI-1. The repository says headline scores average multiple seeds, but its example pages show best-seed results among eight. These are first-party reported results on public evaluation tasks, not a private leaderboard result or an independent reproduction. The linked code and evaluation recipe were inspected at the README level but not executed or audited.

item.title: Acceptance-aware training improves reported speculative-decoding acceptance length in matched regimes
item.description: A September 21, 2026 arXiv preprint introduces expected-accepted-length (EAL) training for greedy verification and window-total-variation (WTV) training for sampling-based speculative decoding. Across author-run Qwen3 and Gemma4 configurations and five benchmarks, the authors report higher mean acceptance lengths for matched objectives, with larger gains under sampling than greedy verification. In Qwen3-8B/Qwen3-0.6B tree decoding, WTV raises reported mean acceptance length from 4.998 to 5.750 at temperature 1.0 and from 4.304 to 4.780 at 0.5; under greedy verification, KL+EAL changes 4.494 to 4.503 while WTV alone is weaker at 4.428. The paper measures acceptance length, not end-to-end latency or serving cost. These results are claimed by the preprint authors and have not been independently reproduced.
